gauge.name: Escambia River near Century

impacts.statement: Record Flood of 1929 - Severe flooding in Century.
Some flooding in the eastern sections of Century.
Second Flood of Record Hurricenae George - Water enters several houses on Worley Road, Daffin Road, and Fairground Road.

Second highest record flood - Approximately 8 houses become isolated and sections of Mystic Springs Road, River Bend Road and Fairground Road are impassable. Water from the river flows into ponds at B and L Catfish Farm on Mystic Road.

Widespread flooding of pasture and farm land. Water begins to reach Mystic Springs Road, Worley Road, Mamer Holley Lane and River Bend Road. Approximately 5 houses become isolated in the McDavid and Molino communities. Public boat ramps at Mystic Springs and Fairground Road are submerged.
Low lying pastures will flood. Cattle should be moved to higher ground.
Minor overflow of lowlands in the area.

dataAttribution.title: Observations courtesy of U.S. Geological Survey

hydronotes.statement: River forecasts for this location take into account past precipitation and the precipitation amounts expected approximately 48 hours into the future from the forecast issuance time.

gauge.forecastReliability: Forecasts are issued as needed during times of high water, but are not routinely available.
